summary: Retested the menu fix, public APIs, desktop flows, and 390px layout. Backend and core dashboard flows pass; live mode now updates telemetry correctly. Demo scenario controls remain absent from the frontend.

integration_issues.issue: The backend supports normal/flood/earthquake/cyclone scenarios, but App.js renders no scenario selector or scenario buttons, so users cannot exercise the requested demo scenarios from the frontend.

action_items: Add frontend demo scenario controls wired to runAnalysis({scenario}) and expose them with unique data-testid attributes.
Consider adding data-testid attributes to financial alert/entity rows if they are intended as critical test targets.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js defines scenario state but never renders a control that changes it; the requested demo scenario workflow is therefore unreachable through the UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public root/financial/demo analysis/invalid-coordinate APIs passed. Hover menu, settings live-stream transition, Enter search, protocol feedback, financial rendering, desktop load, and 390px overflow passed. Scenario UI remains unimplemented. GET /api/financial and demo-mode POST /api/analyze are MOCKED deterministic data by design.
rca of the issue: scenario state is initialized in App.js and sent by runAnalysis, but no JSX control updates scenario. Consequently the only reachable analysis modes are the initial normal demo and live toggle; flood/earthquake/cyclone cannot be selected from the dashboard.
